note: New knowledge pack (ticket #805, frontend wave 1). Fences: make-component owns a component's own anatomy/API/geometry realization; ui-pattern-facts owns UI-pattern naming and the screen-state grammar (loading/empty/error) — a 'reactive state' ask (signals/effects) and a 'screen state' ask share vocabulary but are different axes. Amended ticket #806 (frontend wave 2): state-model-rules owns app-tier state ARCHITECTURE judgment (stacked generations, tagged-union-vs-same-fact, adoption verdicts, never-pulled triggers, doctrine-vs-practice divergence, one-name-two-owners) — this pack stays scoped to reactivity MECHANISM (kernel/recompute/disposal/staleness/scheduling); n12-n13 are the reciprocal no-trigger cases. Amended ticket #807 (frontend wave 3): persistence-facts owns client-persistence facts (storage discipline tiers, dual sync/async contracts, storage-specific bypass shape, URL-state sync) — n14 is the reciprocal no-trigger case. Amended ticket #808 (frontend wave 4): data-wiring-facts owns how data gets CONNECTED (streaming stack, postMessage bridge protocol, no-DI substitutes, the wiring-pattern menu) — n15 is the reciprocal no-trigger case. Amended ticket #809 (frontend wave 5): web-component-facts owns stamping STRATEGY/mechanism (which of the three strategies, keyed reconcile, the display:contents trap) — n16 is the reciprocal no-trigger case; this pack stays scoped to the reactivity KERNEL (signal/computed/effect/scope) that decides WHEN a re-stamp fires. Fixed 2026-08-20 (ticket #821, post-campaign routing tune): t10 was stolen 3-of-3 by state-model-rules — description gained "parametric doc + derive-then-render vs fine-grained signals" verbatim.
